description: This file is a Streamlit application script for a Medical Exam Preparation Chatbot that implements Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). It manages UI layout, session state, and integrates with vector store and OpenAI API to answer questions based on textbook content, with features like chapter selection, chat history, and context retrieval.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class managing local vector storage and search functionalities.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class responsible for generating text embeddings for search queries.

classes.name: AsyncOpenAI
classes.description: A class for asynchronous interaction with OpenAI's API.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronous function that performs retrieval-augmented generation by embedding the question, searching relevant chunks, and generating a detailed answer with citations.
